tools.name: SchoolAI
tools.description:
SchoolAI is an AI writing tool designed for the education sector, helping teachers and schools save hours by automating repetitive writing tasks. With SchoolAI, users can personalize their results and write any kind of document for schools, including reports, lesson plans, marking, emails, brainstorms, quizzes, and more. This tool comes with various modes, including Email/Letter, Mark and Grade, Lesson Plan, Quiz, Resource from Learn Plan, and Brainstorm, making it a versatile and time-saving solution for educators. With the Time Saved counter, users can keep track of how much time they have saved across all their documents. 

## Key Features 🚀
- Automates repetitive writing tasks for educators
- Personalized results for users
- Various modes for different writing tasks
- Time Saved counter to track saved time

## Main Use Case 📚
- Teachers can quickly produce drafts for emails or letters to parents, staff, or students using the Email/Letter mode, saving time and effort.
- With the Mark and Grade mode, teachers can easily mark assignments, essays, and homework, and generate grades quickly.
- The Lesson Plan mode allows teachers to create lesson plans quickly and easily, and generate resources for the lesson plan using the Resource from Learn Plan mode
useCases: Personalized student tutoring and homework assistance, Educator lesson structuring and quiz creation, Academic literature review and conceptual breakdown
